parts:
Thanks. Sverre is also having to sort out a lot of trouble Anthony Unwin is having getting
connected.

Not quite sure what this Sooraj character was up to, but he put his name down for every
GSoC project proposal in every org that did not have mentor assigned. Perhaps he thought
there was money or something. His name still is listed as a possible mentor, but Sverre
purged him from the system.

Best, JN

PS. I responded to your and Hadley's comment about the optimgui project proposal. Possibly
I should have made clear in the initial suggestion that the goal is not directly the
choice of optimization engine but a structure to allow user to build a function etc. and
then be guided to one. The guidance needs to be built by a group of folk with a lot of
experience. In part the woes with optim() are because some very ad hoc decisions were
made. But we need the GUI or menu structure in place so the functions can be built by
folks who are novices in optimization, even if experts otherwise.
